skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Drafts internal communication formats such as 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
skill.summary: Guides AI assistants through concise internal company communication formats.
skill.author: Azeem-2

content.value_statement: Teams lose time turning scattered updates into clear internal messages. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to draft concise newsletters, 3P updates, FAQs, and general communications.
actual_capabilities: Selects an internal communication format based on the request.
Drafts strict 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Structures company newsletters into short, grouped bullet updates.
Creates employee FAQ responses from company questions and source material.
Asks for audience, purpose, tone, and format when the request is unclear.
Encourages links to authoritative company sources when available.
limitations: It does not access Slack, email, calendar, or documents unless the host tool already grants access.
It does not verify facts without provided source material or connected tools.
It does not replace legal, HR, or executive review for sensitive announcements.
It may need user clarification for audience, time period, or communication type.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team Reporting
use_cases.description: Convert team notes into a concise 3P update with progress, plans, and blockers.

use_cases.title: Company Newsletter Drafting
use_cases.description: Group announcements, milestones, and links into a short newsletter for Slack or email.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ Alignment
use_cases.description: Turn recurring employee questions into clear answers with source links and uncertainty notes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: format supplied notes into a weekly team update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a concise 3P update for [team] covering [dates]. Use these notes: [paste notes]. Ask for missing team name or time period before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize several announcements for broad internal distribution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company-wide newsletter for [time period] using these announcements, links, and milestones: [paste source material]. Keep bullets short and group related updates.

prompt_templates.title: Answer Employee FAQs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: summarize confusion from several sources into employee-facing answers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these announcements, questions, and source links: [paste material]. Produce six to eight employee FAQ entries with clear answers, uncertainty notes, and authoritative links.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Leadership Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reshape leadership notes for a specific audience and channel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these leadership notes into an internal update for [audience]. Match [tone], lead with impact, include links, and flag missing context before finalizing.

output_examples.input: Draft a weekly 3P update for the platform team from launch notes, hiring progress, and two blockers.
output: Progress: Shipped the new deployment dashboard and closed three reliability issues.
Plans: Complete billing service migration and prepare the launch review.
Problems: Two open vendor approvals may delay the staging rollout.

output_examples.input: Create a company newsletter from executive announcements, product milestones, and recruiting updates.
output: Company Announcements: New regional launch plan shared by leadership.
Progress on Priorities: Product reached beta readiness for the analytics workspace.
People Updates: Recruiting opened five roles across support and engineering.

output_examples.input: Summarize employee questions about a new planning process into FAQ answers.
output: Question: When does the new planning cycle start?
Answer: The cycle starts next Monday, based on the planning memo.
Answer: Functional leaders approve team priorities after finance review.

best_practices: Provide source notes, audience, time period, and desired channel before requesting a draft.
Review generated drafts for confidentiality, tone, and factual accuracy before sharing.
Use authoritative links and mark uncertain information clearly.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to infer confidential details from private channels without authorization.
Do not publish drafts without review by the accountable owner.
Do not mix company-wide news with granular team-only updates.

faq.question: What types of communications can it draft?
faq.answer: It can draft 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does it collect information by itself?
faq.answer: No. It can use connected tools only when your environment grants access, otherwise it asks for source material.

faq.question: Can it write strict 3P updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Progress, Plans, and Problems sections with concise, data-driven language.

faq.question: Can it make newsletters for Slack and email?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates short grouped bullet updates designed for broad employee reading.

faq.question: How should sensitive updates be handled?
faq.answer: Provide only authorized source material and route drafts through the responsible reviewer before sharing.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
